name: MonarchDecisionCard
title: DecisionCard
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with Button rows, TextField(axis: .vertical), MonarchButton and MonarchBadge
summary: Records a decision about an item (keep, review, let lapse) with a reason, next to the evidence for it, and shows who decided and when.
whenToUse: When a person must choose one of two to five outcomes for a record and others should see the choice and the reason.
whenNotToUse: For a simple confirmation use the system confirmationDialog. For a choice with no reason and no record, use a Picker.
api: init(_ title: String? = nil, options: [MonarchDecisionOption], value: String?, reason: String? = nil, decidedAt: Date? = nil, decidedBy: String? = nil, now: Date? = nil, allowsNone: Bool = true, isReasonRequired: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, labels: MonarchDecisionCardLabels = MonarchDecisionCardLabels(), reasonLimit: Int = 500, onDecide: (@MainActor (MonarchDecision) async throws -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder context: () -> Context)

init(_ title: String? = nil, options: [MonarchDecisionOption], value: String?, reason: String? = nil, decidedAt: Date? = nil, decidedBy: String? = nil, now: Date? = nil, allowsNone: Bool = true, isReasonRequired: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, labels: MonarchDecisionCardLabels = MonarchDecisionCardLabels(), reasonLimit: Int = 500, onDecide: (@MainActor (MonarchDecision) async throws -> Void)? = nil) where Context == EmptyView

struct MonarchDecisionOption { init(_ label: String, value: String, description: String? = nil, note: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, isReasonRequired: Bool? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false) }
struct MonarchDecision { init(value: String?, reason: String? = nil) }

struct MonarchDecisionCardLabels { init(choices: String? = nil, none: String? = nil, reason: String? = nil, reasonOptional: String? = nil, reasonPrompt: String? = nil, reasonRequired: String? = nil, charactersLeft: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, save: String? = nil, saved: String? = nil, decided: String? = nil, undecided: String? = nil, failed: String? = nil) }

options.name: options
options.description: The choices, in order. Each has a label, a value, and optionally a description, a note shown while selected, a badge tone, its own reason rule and a disabled flag.

options.name: value
options.description: The saved decision, or nil for none.

options.name: decidedAt
options.description: When the saved decision was made. Shown as a relative time.

options.name: allowsNone
options.description: Offers a "No decision" choice that clears the decision.

options.name: isReasonRequired
options.description: Every choice needs a reason. An option's own isReasonRequired overrides it.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Shows the decision as a badge with the reason, without the form.

options.name: reasonLimit
options.description: The longest reason accepted, in characters.

options.name: onDecide
options.description: Saves the decision. Without it the card is read-only.

options.name: context
options.description: Evidence for the decision, shown above the choices.

options.name: now
options.description: The date the decided line is measured from; the current time by default.

states.name: unchanged
states.description: The Save button is disabled while the form equals the saved decision.

states.name: selected choice
states.description: The row has an accent border, a subtle accent fill and a filled checkmark glyph; its note is shown under the choices.

states.name: reason missing
states.description: After Save is activated without a required reason, the field has a danger border and an error message with an icon.

states.name: near the limit
states.description: From 50 characters left, the number left is shown under the reason.

states.name: saving
states.description: The choices and the reason are disabled and the button shows progress until onDecide returns.

states.name: failed
states.description: The choice is kept and the error is shown with an icon above the button.

states.name: read-only
states.description: A badge in the option's tone, or "No decision yet", then the reason and who decided when.

appearance: A card on the surface colour. Choices are bordered rows on the surface colour; the selected row uses the subtle accent fill and the strong accent border. The reason field looks like MonarchTextField. Errors use the strong danger colour with an icon.
platformNotes: The web card uses radio inputs and a Textarea. iOS has no radio button and a Picker cannot show a description under each option outside a List, so the choices are button rows with a checkmark and the selected trait; the reason is a multi-line TextField drawn with the tokens of MonarchTextField. onDecide is an async throwing closure instead of a function that may return a promise. The web headingLevel, now and locale properties have no counterpart: the title is a heading, and the time uses the user's locale and is redrawn every minute.
accessibility: Each choice is a button with the selected trait, read as its label and description, inside a group named "Decision".
Selection is a glyph as well as a colour.
The note of a newly selected choice is announced.
A missing reason is announced and shown with an icon and text; it is also the hint of the field.
A successful save and a failed save are announced.
The time of the decision is read as an absolute date and time.
Every choice is at least 44 points high and the Save button has a 44-point touch target.
edgeCases: A new value or reason from the app resets the form.
A reason of white space only counts as empty, and the reason is trimmed before it is passed to onDecide.
Text beyond reasonLimit is cut as it is typed or pasted.
An error that is not a LocalizedError shows the built-in failure text.
The built-in "characters left" text uses the English plural rule; pass labels.charactersLeft for other languages.
If the view is removed while onDecide runs, the task still finishes.
With allowsNone false and no saved value, no choice is selected and Save stays disabled until one is chosen.

examples.title: Renewal decision with evidence
examples.template:
MonarchDecisionCard(
    {{title}},
    options: options,
    value: saved.value,
    reason: saved.reason,
    decidedAt: {{decidedAt|date}},
    decidedBy: {{decidedBy}},
    now: {{now|date}},
    onDecide: { decision in saved = decision },
    context: {
        HStack {
            Text({{context.label}})
            MonarchBadge({{context.badge}}, tone: .info)
            Text({{context.text}})
        }
        .monarchTextStyle(.body)
    }
)
examples.code:
MonarchDecisionCard(
    "Renewal decision",
    options: options,
    value: saved.value,
    reason: saved.reason,
    decidedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_778_230_800),
    decidedBy: "Alex Morgan",
    now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_778_414_400),
    onDecide: { decision in saved = decision },
    context: {
        HStack {
            Text("Usage:")
            MonarchBadge("Active", tone: .info)
            Text("Serves a website and email.")
        }
        .monarchTextStyle(.body)
    }
)

examples.title: Read-only
examples.code:
MonarchDecisionCard(
    "Renewal decision",
    options: [MonarchDecisionOption("Let lapse", value: "lapse", tone: .danger)],
    value: "lapse",
    reason: "Nobody has signed in since March.",
    decidedBy: "Ana",
    isReadOnly: true
)
